summary.text: Asheville, Nashville, Louisville, Cincinnati, Indianapolis are the highest-scoring cities on Qloo room affinity for S.G. Goodman's audience that sit within a day's drive of each other. Each stop below names the neighbourhood where those fans cluster.

theme.text: Storytelling Sessions: intimate stage setups where S.G. Goodman performs stripped-down songs with sustained focus on lyrical detail and emotional narrative.
Loss & Resilience: thematic show exploring the empathetic, evocative songwriting that defines the act's connection with this audience.
Southern Voices: a night celebrating Authentic storytelling rooted in Narrative Rich songcraft and Southern Gothic sensibility.

merch.text: Limited-edition vinyl pressing of S.G. Goodman's most Narrative Rich album, housed in hand-screened jacket art inspired by Southern Gothic imagery.
Merch collaboration with Tecovas or Stetson—boots or hats reflecting the Western, Red Dirt aesthetic this audience gravitates toward.
Handwritten lyric sheets or limited chapbook of S.G. Goodman's most Evocative, Loss-centered lyrics, signed per show.

risks.text: Venue availability and routing logistics (city-to-city travel, especially across the full Asheville-to-Indianapolis span) may require date shifts or rerouting.
This data scores only five cities; competing shows, seasonality, and regional events in each market could affect turnout independent of audience affinity.
